checks.check: every landed review record appears in the provenance table
every high-severity finding's passage has an entry
every passage where the two independent readings differed has an entry
the document is REPRODUCIBLE from the records alone, which is how 'nothing asserted that is not in a record' is established rather than asserted
every section item 20 names is present
every dispute entry carries evidence on each side
no campaign vocabulary leaks into the body (the provenance table, the substitution table and the apparatus's own words are excluded, with reasons given in the source)
the substitution table that de-privatises quoted prose is present, so a reader can invert it

what_a_pass_does_not_establish: that the reviewers were RIGHT. This checker establishes that the document faithfully and completely represents what they recorded. Whether their readings of the Hebrew are correct is what the post-flight audit against the primary sources is for.
